hud.title: FRONTLINE DUEL
hud.objective: Break the opposing command core before yours falls.
hud.gatherHint: Select harvesters, then right-click a crystal field to bring home 20 crystals.
hud.trainHint: Select your command core and press Q to train infantry for 60 crystals.
hud.attackHint: Select infantry, then right-click an enemy unit or core to engage.
hud.waitingText: Waiting for both commanders to ready up.
hud.drawText: The battle ends in a draw
